components.allowTrivial: The AETHER export ships an 18-bone skeleton; a lower count is a load failure, not a scene difference.
The retargeted walk moves the limb bones; a still pose is the regression this catches.
AETHER's rigid segment lengths are preserved by construction; any drift is a skinning regression.
attachToBone holds the weapon in the runtime hand bone (handR); relative drift proves the bind does not slide.
The reported attachment bone is the runtime value, not the authored constant.
A zero scale would mean the attachment collapsed the weapon.
The six-clip export keeps namespaced ids and drops AETHER's originals.
AETHER's preexisting clips must not survive the game-minimal export.
An 18-bone rotation bake emits at least one track per joint.
The source 14-unit AETHER size is retained unless the sample overrides it.
